newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt weaver with 1.1 pound 95/6 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Egypt weaver with 1.1 pound 95/6 dividend.

text.p: Egypt's Alexandria Spinning and Weaving/Spinalex said on Sunday it will give a 1.1199 pound dividend for each of its 1.926 million shares for the 1995/6 financial year.
It did not specify a dividend for the previous year but corporate sources said the payout in 1994/5 was 1.01 pounds. The years end on June 30.
The state privatised 96,400 of the shares in 1994.

The firm, which published its results in Cairo newspapers, also said it had decided to double capital to 3.851 million pounds ($1.133 million) from 1.926 million by offering investors one free share for every one they already hold.
Spinalex said it increased net after-tax profits for 1995/6 to 7.199 million pounds from 7.023 million in 1994/5.
Earlier this year, official state sources put Spinalex's unaudited 1995/6 profits at 880,000 pounds, 88 percent down on 7.2 million in the previous year.
